title: Expense Agent: add approval conversation to expense reports
summary: The Expense Agent now supports approval conversations by storing submitter comments, exposing them through the API, adding a pending-approval action with optional comments, and recording comments in activity events.
key_points: The latest submitter comment is stored on the Expense Report Header
The Expense Reports API exposes both latest comments
New capability-backed pending-approval action that takes an optional comment
Comments are recorded on the existing Submitted/Resubmitted and Rejected activity events
Historical comments are shortened with an ellipsis, and the existing Expense Report page extension point is kept
quote: Add Business Central support for the Expense Agent approval conversation.
